description: Plant Simulation, part of Siemens' Tecnomatix portfolio, is discrete-event simulation software for digitally validating manufacturing and logistics systems before and during new product introductions. Users build well-structured, three-dimensional hierarchical models of production facilities, lines and operations for discrete and continuous manufacturing with an object-oriented architecture, libraries or external CAD data in the JT format. Built-in analyses cover automatic bottleneck detection, throughput, machine, resource and buffer utilisation, energy consumption and cost, with Sankey diagrams and Gantt charts, and experiment management with neural networks and genetic algorithms automates optimisation. Products are Plant Simulation X Essentials (up to 500 objects), Standard (up to 4,000 objects), Advanced, a Runtime edition for running experiments on existing models and a value stream mapping library, and the digital twin of production can be linked to operations. It is used globally in manufacturing. Access is commercial through Siemens; prices are not given on the page read. Caveats: proprietary, with object limits by edition, and models need detailed process data. For simulation it models material flow, throughput and energy use of factories and logistics centres for capacity, disruption and digital twin studies. Related catalogue records include FlexSim, Simio and Eclipse BaSyx.
